technologies.lead: Each technology does one thing well. The value is in combining them on the same label, in register.

items.title: Digital printing
items.text: High-resolution digital colour, from short runs to industrial volumes.

items.title: Hot foil
items.text: Metallic foil applied with heat and pressure: gold, silver, holographic or custom.

items.title: Screen printing
items.text: Dense, opaque colour and thick varnish layers on top of the print.

items.title: Embossing
items.text: Relief raised from the paper, on its own or in register with foil.

items.title: Debossing
items.text: Details pressed into the surface for a quieter, engraved look.

items.title: High-build tactile effects
items.text: Thick varnish you can feel under a fingertip.

items.title: Microtextures
items.text: Fine relief patterns that change how a surface catches the light.

items.title: Die-cutting
items.text: Shaped profiles with points, curves and recesses, cut in register.

items.title: Reverse printing
items.text: Printing on the adhesive side, seen through the container or the product.

items.title: Multilayer / booklet labels
items.text: More room for text without a bigger label.

items.title: Variable data
items.text: Codes, names, batches and QR codes that change on every label.

items.title: Numbering
items.text: Sequential numbers for limited editions and traceability.

items.title: Lamination
items.text: A protective film over the print, gloss or matt.

items.title: Colour measurement and control
items.text: Spectral colour measurement, checked against the target.

landings.lead: UltraPixel makes premium self-adhesive labels where material, print and finishing are designed together, for products that have to be noticed on the shelf.
cap: Foil, screen varnish and relief in register
mats: Material proposed after seeing the product
faq: What makes a label premium?
The material and the finishing: textured stock, foil, relief and varnish that react to light and touch, all in register.
Can several finishes be combined on one label?
Yes. Print, foil, screen varnish and relief are applied in register on the same label.
Can I see samples first?
Yes. Request a sample kit.
shots: Premium label, foil and relief in raking light

Gold, silver, holographic and custom finishes.

A thick layer of screen varnish that you can feel under a fingertip.

faq: What is the difference between embossing and debossing?
Embossing raises a detail from the surface; debossing presses it in.
Can relief be combined with foil?
Yes. Foil can be raised with the relief in register.
Does embossing work on textured paper?
Yes. Textured and natural papers take relief well; we confirm the result with a sample.

meta.title: Sustainability and label material choices | UltraPixel
meta.description: How UltraPixel approaches sustainability in labels: material selection, sourcing, waste, compatibility with the pack and the right level of finishing, evaluated from the start of a project.

sustainability.intro: Sustainability in labels starts with material choice, construction, production efficiency and compatibility with the final packaging. We help customers evaluate these variables from the beginning of a project.

s1.p: UltraPixel can evaluate label materials according to application, packaging substrate, visual requirements and end-of-life objectives.
rows: Chosen with the container and its recovery in mind

s2.p: Certified and responsibly sourced material options can be evaluated according to project requirements and supplier availability.
s2.note: Any certification is stated per material, only when it is documented for that material.

s3.h: Use what matters. Reduce what doesn't.
rows: Labels arranged to use the width of the material.
The web is chosen for the job, not the other way round.
Printing what is needed, when the run suits it.
Fewer unnecessary set-ups and fewer labels printed in advance.
Recurring orders reviewed so that each reprint wastes less.

s4.h: The label is part of the pack.
s4.p: Material compatibility matters. A beautiful label should also be designed with the packaging system it becomes part of.
s4.p2: A sustainable choice does not depend on the label alone. Container, adhesive, facestock, decoration and recycling stream have to be considered together.

s5.p: We help customers judge when a finish adds value to the product and when it only adds complexity and material. Foil, lamination and premium finishing have their place; the point is to choose them on purpose.

s6.h: Made in Italy. Connected to Europe.
s6.p: Production in the Trieste area and a European supply network allow us to work closely with customers and material partners across the EU.

s7.p: These are objectives, not results. We will publish outcomes when they can be measured.

meta.title: Privacy policy | UltraPixel
meta.description: How UltraPixel Srl handles personal data collected through this website.

sections: Who is responsible

The data controller is UltraPixel Srl, Via J. Ressel 3, 34018 San Dorligo della Valle (TS), Italy, VAT IT01240410322. You can write to us at info@ultrapixel.it for anything concerning your personal data.
Requests you send us

When you send a request for samples, a quote, a conversation or a partnership, we receive what you write in the form: name, company, country, email address, sector, type of request and message. Together with the request we record the date and time, the page of this site you came from, the first page you visited, the website that referred you to us and any campaign parameters in the link you followed.
Label price calculator

When you use the price page, the photo or file you upload and the values you enter (size, material, finishes and quantity) are sent to our server to read the label and calculate the price. The image is used only for this reading and is not stored. Nothing in this step identifies you, unless you then choose to send us a request. The reading of the image may be carried out by an external provider acting as data processor.
Why we use this data

We use it to answer your request and to prepare quotes or samples, which are steps taken at your request before a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). We use the information about where a request came from to understand which channels bring us enquiries, on the basis of our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). We do not use your data for automated decisions or profiling, and we do not sell it.
Usage statistics

We count page views, clicks on the request buttons, forms started and sent, and the type of source a visit came from (for example a search engine, an AI assistant, a social network or a direct visit). These statistics are collected by our own system, without cookies and without identifiers that recognise you on a later visit or on other websites. IP addresses are not stored in the statistics.
Who receives the data

Your data is handled by UltraPixel staff and by the providers that host this website, store the requests and deliver email on our behalf, acting as data processors. Where data is processed outside the European Economic Area, this happens under the safeguards required by the GDPR, such as standard contractual clauses.
How long we keep it

We keep requests for as long as needed to handle them and for the commercial relationship that follows. If no relationship follows, we delete them within 24 months. Usage statistics are kept in aggregate form.
Your rights

You can ask us for access to your data, for its correction or deletion, for the restriction of its processing, and for a copy in a portable format; you can also object to processing based on legitimate interest. Write to info@ultrapixel.it. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian data protection authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali) or with the authority of your country.

meta.title: Cookie policy | UltraPixel
meta.description: This website does not use cookies. What it stores in your browser during a visit, and why.

sections: No cookies
This website does not set cookies, neither its own nor those of third parties, and it does not load advertising or social-network trackers. For this reason it does not show a cookie banner.
Session storage

During your visit the site keeps a few items in your browser's session storage: the first page you visited, the website that referred you, any campaign parameters in the link you followed and the previous page you viewed. They stay in your browser and are deleted when you close the tab. They are sent to us only if you send a request through a form, as part of that request.
Statistics
Page views and clicks on the request buttons are counted by our own system without cookies and without identifiers that persist between visits. Details are in the privacy policy.
Fonts and files
Fonts, images and scripts are served from this website. No files are loaded from third-party servers.
Changes
If we introduce cookies or third-party services in the future, this page will be updated first and, where required, you will be asked for consent.
